data.title: 楪祈 · 末世废都
data.description: 【楪祈 · 末世废都】被结晶与残垣断壁吞噬的后启示录废墟街道上，楪祈静静伫立在风沙呼啸的风口，粉橘渐变的长发在废墟间轻扬。她转过身拉住你的衣角，眼神清澈而坚定——「集，我是属于你的容器。无论前方的命运是拯救还是毁灭，我都会永远和你站在一起。」
data.action: 站在结晶废墟街道，转身轻拉穿外套同伴的衣角，目光坚定
data.camera: wide two-shot, jacket-hem contact and rubble path visible
data.promptProse: On the crystal-lined ruined street, Inori turns and gently catches Shu Ouma's jacket hem with one hand, calm crimson eyes sharing a determined route with the clothed companion beside her. White sleeveless top, black shorts and red ribbon retain her combat outfit. The wide horizontal two-shot follows a clear path through rubble. Grey daylight illuminates their separate silhouettes and the hand-to-cloth contact, with fractured crystal reflecting paler light between broken stones.
